body.name: Q_{\ell,F}^a
body.space: supported arm-\(a\) histories through \(\ell\) to \([0,1]\) for indicator outcomes
body.def: The backward outcome regression with terminal value \(Q_{K,F}^a=F\) and \(Q_{\ell-1,F}^a(h)=\mathsf E\{Q_{\ell,F}^a(\mathcal H_\ell^a)\mid\mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a=h\}\) on alive supported histories.
